neighbours.label: Reporting back findings after going out to observe or inspect ('visit the colony and report his observations', 'reported back their findings', 'wrote up a report'), firing on the reporting verb; the same trips without a report stay quiet.
fire: The envoy toured the northern provinces and reported to the emperor what he had seen.
Inspectors visited every school in the district and reported their findings to the minister.
She spent a month in the camps and wrote a report on the conditions there.
The scouts crossed the ridge and came back to report the enemy's position.
Volunteers walked the coastline and reported the numbers of nesting birds.
A commission travelled to the colony to investigate and report its observations.
The journalist lived among the miners and wrote about their working lives.
Field teams sampled the wells and reported the results back to the agency.
quiet: The envoy toured the northern provinces and rested at a monastery.
Inspectors visited every school in the district during the spring term.
She spent a month in the camps and helped in the kitchens there.
The scouts crossed the ridge and set up camp near the stream.
Volunteers walked the coastline and picked up plastic litter.
A commission travelled to the colony by ship in the autumn.
The journalist lived among the miners for most of a year.
Field teams drilled the wells and installed new pumps for the agency.

short: reporting back findings after a visit
notes: Card: peaks on ' report' x5, ' data' x4, ' back', ' wrote' (we had to report to him; visit the colony and report his observations; wrote sympathetically about); output promotes ' results', ' obtained', ' estimates', ' outputs'. Exploratory probe: report/wrote after a visit 0.26-0.94, the same trips without a report 0.01; code 'value' 0.04.
